site_and_repo_defects_found_on_044c45e.defect:
Renders `

1

` because `len(SUGGESTIONS_HEAD)` evaluates the length of a 1-item list instead of `SUGGESTIONS_HEAD[0]`.
Calls Wing Lei 'the cheapest starred dinner on this site ($397.76 for two)', directly violating F-03 (Wing Lei is Recommended, NOT starred).
Six duplicate flag IDs (`F-52`..`F-57`) from concurrent PR merges produce duplicate HTML `id` attributes on `flagged.html` and raw loose text in `FLAGS.md`.
`wing-lei.days` reads `'Thu, Sun, Mon'`, omitting Friday and Saturday even though Wing Lei is open Thu–Mon (until 10:00 PM Fri–Sat).

Nine hotel `official_url` entries remained `blocked`, `sibling`, or `no` despite live property subdomains/pages answering 200 OK; `caesars-palace.notes` falsely claimed Caesars is the 'only property with a starred restaurant under its own roof' (MGM Grand has 2★ Joël Robuchon + 1★ L'Atelier; Cosmopolitan has 1★ é); `official_link_check` tally conflicted with its own array lengths.

`esthers-kitchen` retained stale address `1130 S Casino Center Blvd` and blank hours/phone despite `estherslv.com/location/esthers-kitchen/` publishing `1131 S. Main Street`, `702-570-7864`, and full Lunch/Brunch/Dinner hours; 6 menu-verified restaurant prices in `scripts/t17_apply_verified.py` were lost during PR #53 merge, leaving `itinerary.html` Day 7 claiming SoulBelly has an official couple price next to a blank price badge.

`bouchon.social_evidence` still had `'Coral Coral Gables'`; `pho-ga-bac-bac.notes` still cited abandoned `@bestchickenpho`; `transit.json` had stale $1 local-fare text, stale 5-station Vegas Loop list, missing `Yen Viet Kitchen` in `west-near` zone restaurants, and inverted 34-min vs 20/25-min Chinatown bus estimates.
